metas.name: Legally Blonde
metas.description: Matches the stylish, optimistic, and sharp comedic tone of Clueless.

metas.name: Mean Girls
metas.description: A high-school comedy classic with witty writing that fans of 10 Things I Hate About You will love.

metas.name: Stardust
metas.description: A whimsical fantasy adventure that captures the same magical charm as D&D: Honor Among Thieves and Fantastic Beasts.

metas.name: Guardians of the Galaxy
metas.description: Features the same blend of high-octane action, humor, and cosmic adventure as Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: Game Night
metas.description: A fast-paced, hilarious ensemble comedy that aligns with the energy of Jumanji and The Nice Guys.

metas.name: Glass Onion: A Knives Out Mystery
metas.description: Since you enjoy the Knives Out franchise, this sequel offers more colorful characters and clever mystery-comedy.

metas.name: Kiss Kiss Bang Bang
metas.description: Written and directed by Shane Black, it shares the exact snappy buddy-detective DNA as The Nice Guys.

metas.name: The Princess Bride
metas.description: A gold standard for lighthearted fantasy, romance, and comedy that fits your comfort-movie profile.

metas.name: Bullet Train
metas.description: A neon-soaked, high-energy action comedy that feels like Thor: Ragnarok meets a crime caper.

metas.name: Free Guy
metas.description: A joyful, video-game-themed adventure that matches the 'stuck in a game' fun of the modern Jumanji films.

metas.name: Hot Fuzz
metas.description: A brilliant parody of action movies with sharp wit, perfect for fans of the comedy-crime hybrid in Get Shorty.

metas.name: The Mummy
metas.description: Provides the perfect balance of adventure, light horror elements, and comedic timing seen in D&D: Honor Among Thieves.

metas.name: Kingsman: The Secret Service
metas.description: Stylish, high-octane fun that reinvents the spy genre with a comedic, high-energy edge.

metas.name: Logan Lucky
metas.description: A quirky 'hillbilly heist' movie that captures the clever crime-comedy vibe of Get Shorty.

metas.name: Easy A
metas.description: A smart, modern high school comedy inspired by literature, much like 10 Things I Hate About You.

metas.name: Midnight in Paris
metas.description: A light, charming fantasy romance that matches the magical and whimsical tone of Practical Magic.

metas.name: Scott Pilgrim vs. the World
metas.description: Highly stylized, funny, and energetic, appealing to fans of Thor: Ragnarok and Night Is Short, Walk On Girl.

metas.name: Palm Springs
metas.description: A clever and hilarious sci-fi rom-com that is incredibly easy to watch and very uplifting.

metas.name: 21 Jump Street
metas.description: A high-energy buddy-cop comedy with great chemistry, perfect for fans of The Nice Guys.

metas.name: The Lost City
metas.description: A throwback jungle adventure-comedy that mirrors the tone of Jumanji and Anaconda.

metas.name: Borat
metas.description: If you enjoyed the boundary-pushing, awkward humor of Brüno, this is the definitive Sacha Baron Cohen experience.

metas.name: Spy
metas.description: A hilarious action-comedy that doesn't skimp on the high-octane sequences or the laughs.

metas.name: Shazam!
metas.description: A superhero movie with a heart of gold and a focus on fun, adventure, and humor.

metas.name: Confess, Fletch
metas.description: A breezy, dialogue-driven mystery comedy that matches the cool aesthetic of Get Shorty.

metas.name: Paddington 2
metas.description: The ultimate feel-good movie; it is heartwarming, funny, and visually delightful for anyone seeking comfort.

metas.name: The Birdcage
metas.description: A masterclass in ensemble comedy and colorful characters, fitting the 90s aesthetic of your favorites.

metas.name: Zoolander
metas.description: A colorful, absurd comedy set in the world of fashion, echoing the sartorial fun of Clueless.

metas.name: Ocean's Eleven
metas.description: An incredibly smooth, fun heist movie with a stellar cast and a lighthearted, cool atmosphere.

metas.name: Ant-Man
metas.description: One of the most comedic and lighthearted entries in the Marvel universe, focusing on a fun heist plot.

metas.name: She's the Man
metas.description: A hilarious Shakespearean-inspired teen comedy that pairs perfectly with 10 Things I Hate About You.

metas.name: Love and Monsters
metas.description: A surprisingly charming post-apocalyptic adventure with a light touch and great creature design.

metas.name: The Mask
metas.description: Another high-energy Jim Carrey classic that matches the zany comedic energy of Ace Ventura.

metas.name: Enchanted
metas.description: A playful deconstruction of fairy tales that offers the same magical romance found in Practical Magic.

metas.name: Popstar: Never Stop Never Stopping
metas.description: A riotous mockumentary about the music industry that shares the satirical edge of Brüno.

metas.name: Big Trouble in Little China
metas.description: A cult classic that blends martial arts, fantasy, and comedy into one high-octane adventure.

metas.name: A Simple Favor
metas.description: A stylish, twisty mystery with a comedic undertone, great for fans of Knives Out.

metas.name: Bring It On
metas.description: An iconic 2000s teen comedy with high energy and the same competitive wit as Clueless.

metas.name: The Mitchells vs. the Machines
metas.description: A visually inventive and hilarious family adventure that captures the fun of sci-fi comedy.

metas.name: The Fugitive
metas.description: While a thriller, it has a propulsive, fun energy and high-quality pacing that fans of 90s cinema appreciate.

metas.name: Everything Everywhere All at Once
metas.description: A wild, imaginative, and ultimately uplifting journey that blends high-concept sci-fi with deep comedy.
